base: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE new finished full-bleed landscape 4:3 card illustration. The input image is the exact CHARACTER AND DRAWING STYLE reference, not an edit target. Match this funny flat chibi comic Roxy consistently: blue hair with EXACTLY TWO chunky braids (one per side), charcoal floppy witch hat with cream/tan band, tan cloak, cream tunic with two dark clasps, dark leggings, cream boots; simple silver forked staff with blue gem when needed. Thick confident slightly imperfect dark navy outlines, large simple solid oval blue eyes, tiny expressive mouth, oversized head and short 2.5-head body. Simple flat color blocks, maximum one hard shadow per surface. Sparse backgrounds, bold action silhouettes, comedic personality like 劣人TV. Do not copy the water-bullet scene. Scene:
suffix: Keep important elements inside central 85% for safe crop to 250x190 pixels. Make face, hands and main prop especially readable at thumbnail size. Fully clothed. No text, letters, numbers, signatures, card border, frame, UI, watermark, gradients, airbrush, 3D, realism, elaborate particles, duplicate limbs or extra braids. A SINGLE coherent scene, no panels or contact sheet.
